title: PMDG 737 (MSFS) - Stream Deck XL
author: ddebart2
notes:
=> Requires: PMDG 737 for MSFS, PilotsDeck 0.9.1+ and the MobiFlight WASM Module (installed by the PilotsDeck Installer).
=> Install to your Stream Deck XL when the Profile Manager asks.
=> Camera keys on the main page use vJoy device 1, buttons 1-12 (vJoy driver required). Bind them in MSFS to 'Load Custom Camera' 1-12 or remove them.
=> Map the profile to the aircraft string 'PMDG 737' in the Profile Manager for automatic switching.
=> GSX folder uses the GSX.lua global script by Fragtality (included).
